capabilities: Reorder month-named folders in the file explorer into calendar order
Detect month folder names in English and the vault language
Rebuild the order when files are created, renamed, or deleted
Refresh the ordering manually via a command
disambiguation: It does not rename or sort files in the vault; it only changes display order in the built-in File Explorer via CSS.
extras: Works only with the built-in File Explorer; replacement explorers like Notebook Navigator render their own lists and are not affected. Install is currently manual. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian sorts folders alphabetically, so month folders for daily notes appear as April, August, December instead of January through December.
summary: Plugin that displays month-named folders in the file explorer in calendar order instead of alphabetical order.
